title: Repository rulesets
description: Repository rulesets. Set to null (~) to remove all managed rulesets. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#rulesets

ruleset.description: A single ruleset, in exactly one of two styles: the raw payload style (target, enforcement, conditions, rules, bypass_actors), forwarded to the GitHub Rulesets API as-is, or the convenience style (all other keys). Mixing keys from both styles is an error.

rawRuleset.title: Raw payload ruleset
rawRuleset.description: A ruleset payload forwarded to the GitHub Rulesets API as-is. At least one of target, enforcement, conditions, rules and bypass_actors must be present, otherwise the entry is treated as a convenience style ruleset.

name.description: Name of the ruleset. Must be unique within the list.

target.description: The ruleset target, e.g. branch or tag.

enforcement.description: The enforcement level, e.g. active, evaluate or disabled.

conditions.description: Ref name conditions, forwarded to the GitHub Rulesets API as-is.

rules.description: The list of rules, forwarded to the GitHub Rulesets API as-is.

bypass_actors.description: The list of bypass actors, forwarded to the GitHub Rulesets API as-is.

convenienceRuleset.title: Convenience ruleset
convenienceRuleset.description: A ruleset described with convenience keys, translated to a GitHub Rulesets API payload with enforcement set to active.

name.description: Name of the ruleset. Must be unique within the list.

type.description: Whether the ruleset applies to branches or tags.

branches.description: Branch names the ruleset applies to. Entries are prefixed with refs/heads/ unless they already start with refs/ or ~. Defaults to the repository default branch for branch rulesets.

refs.description: Fully qualified refs the ruleset applies to, used as-is.

bypass_teams.description: Teams allowed to bypass the ruleset, as team slugs or numeric ids.

restrict_force_push.description: Prevent force pushes to matching refs.

required_conversation_resolution.description: Require all review conversations to be resolved before merging.

required_pull_request_reviews.description: Require pull request reviews before merging.

required_status_checks.description: Status checks that must pass, as plain context names or objects pinning the reporting GitHub App.

name.description: Name of the status check context.

app_slug.description: Slug or numeric id of the GitHub App that must report the check. -1 accepts any source.

required_status_checks_strict.description: Require branches to be up to date with the base branch before merging.

excludes.description: Refs the ruleset does not apply to.
